description: The UDR with every option away from the Fallout 3 defaults over two deleted references to moveable statics that have no scale of their own (copies of REFR 000648B1 and 00064883 of Fallout3.esm that the port builds and deletes first): the base record becomes [000389C6] (UDRSetMSTTValue), the references move to the height -12345.5 (UDRSetZ on), get the scale 2 in an XSCL of their own (UDRSetScale on) and no player enable parent (UDRSetXESP off). References without a scale keep the case clear of the upstream bug of the scale step, which writes the value into the previous reference's element when a reference has a scale (a deliberate divergence of the port).
